title: Optimized Protocol for RNA Extraction from Insect Samples Using TRIzol Reagent
author: Monique da Silva Bonjour

steps.title: Prepare and Macerate Sample
steps.instruction: Macerate the insect sample while keeping it cold to ensure RNA stability.

substeps.instruction: Cover the crucible with liquid nitrogen to keep the sample cold.
Place approximately 50mg of sample in the crucible.
Remove the wings and macerate the sample, noting that insects have a strong exoskeleton and chitin.

steps.title: Initial Lysis with TRIzol
steps.instruction: Lysis the sample using TRIzol reagent.

substeps.instruction: Add 1mL of TRIzol and wait for it to thaw.
Mix the sample with TRIzol in the crucible.
Transfer the mixture to a 1.5 mL microtube.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the RNA from proteins and DNA using chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of ice-cold chloroform.
Shake the tube vigorously by hand for 15 seconds.
Let the mixture sit at room temperature for 2-3 minutes until separation occurs (pink bottom layer, clear top layer).

steps.title: Centrifuge and Collect Supernatant
steps.instruction: Isolate the aqueous phase containing the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12,000 rpm for 15 min at 4°C.
Carefully transfer the clear top liquid to a new clean, labeled tube, avoiding the white interface of denatured proteins.
Remove 500 µL of the supernatant and add 400 µL of ice-cold isopropanol.
Leave the mixture at room temperature for 10 minutes (do not use -20°C to avoid co-precipitation of contaminants).
Centrifuge at 12,000 rpm for 10 min at 4°C to form a pellet.

steps.title: RNA Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet to remove residual salts and reagents.

substeps.instruction: Remove the isopropanol.
Wash the pellet with 1 mL of 75% ethanol.
Centrifuge at 9,500 rpm for 5 min at 4°C.

steps.title: Drying and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Dry the RNA pellet and resuspend it in water.

substeps.instruction: Discard the ethanol, removing as much as possible.
Allow the pellet to air-dry for 5 to 10 minutes at room temperature.
Resuspend the pellet in 30 µL of RNAse-free water (adjust volume based on pellet size).
